The 2025 Openfront Masters Winter Major is the last OFM event of the year.

About

Format

  • 5 trio matches with the top 10 teams of the Minor
  • 25 minutes match duration
  • Each round is a standalone game with immediate prize distribution
  • Winner of each round receives $150
  • Maximum 2 wins per team, if a team wins 2 rounds, they cannot win any additional ones

Maps

The following 5 maps were played in this exact rotation:

  • Achiran
  • Australia
  • Britannia
  • Gatweay to the Atlantic
  • Halkidiki
